Thomson Reuters says its homegrown AI model now rivals the frontier labs, according to LawSites. The company's claim positions its in-house model against the leading AI developers. LawSites reports that it took a closer look at the benchmarks underlying the claim. The post examines the benchmark evidence behind Thomson Reuters' assertion. The source story does not provide specific benchmark figures or model names beyond the comparison to frontier labs. LawSites frames the piece as a closer look at the benchmarks rather than a restatement of the company's claim.
